description: This file contains functions for computing diffs between text contents using Myers algorithm, including line-based and character-based diff functions, with special handling for newlines.

methods.name: convertMyersChangeToDiffLines
methods.description: Converts a Change object from diff library into an array of DiffLine objects with line type annotations.

methods.name: myersDiff
methods.description: Performs a line-based diff between two strings, returning an array of DiffLine objects with types 'same', 'old', or 'new'.

methods.name: myersCharDiff
methods.description: Performs a character-based diff between two strings, returning an array of DiffChar objects with detailed position info, handling newlines separately.
